description: This file defines a Robolectric shadow class for InputMethodManager used in testing. It simulates managing input methods and status icons for an Android soft keyboard, including enabling/disabling input methods, setting the current input method, and showing/hiding status icons.

classes.name: InputMethodManagerShadow
classes.description: A Robolectric shadow class that mimics the behavior of InputMethodManager for testing purposes, including managing input methods and status icons.

methods.name: InputMethodManagerShadow
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shadow with three input methods: ASK, Google, and AOSP.

methods.name: setKeyboardEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables all input methods based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: setKeyboardAsCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current input method to either a soft keyboard or another component, updating system settings.

methods.name: showStatusIcon
methods.description: Displays a status icon for the input method, recording its details.

methods.name: hideStatusIcon
methods.description: Hides the status icon for the input method.

methods.name: isStatusIconShown
methods.description: Returns whether the status icon is currently shown.

methods.name: getLastStatusIconPackageName
methods.description: Returns the package name of the last shown status icon.

methods.name: getLastStatusIconId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID of the last shown status icon.

methods.name: getLastStatusIconImeToken
methods.description: Returns the IME token associated with the last status icon.
